nom: KORRES Greek Yoghurt Probiotic Superdose Face Mask

avis.titre: Smells nasty, but I'm never going without it!
avis.texte: Okay, so, four stars because - This mask smells absolutely DISGUSTING. It's like cheap latex house paint that's been left in a hot garage to degrade. If you're like me and you've used actual probiotic-enhanced Greek yogurt from the supermarket on your face and you think, "oh, this can't be that bad": Think again. This smells nothing like yogurt or like anything that belongs anywhere near your skin. I'm stating this up front because I realize this could be a dealbreaker for a lot of people. Normally, it would be a dealbreaker for me, but hear me out. I've been using this for about three weeks now. I had been dealing with redness, uneven skin, imbalanced moisture, and blackheads like you wouldn't imagine. Reader, I swear to God that all of that is GONE. After years and years of trying everything under the sun, this stuff - this grody, nasty-smelling goop - has done wonders. In two days my skin was perfectly clear, and so moisturized. I haven't felt the uncomfortable heaviness of oil, there hasn't been any dryness, no breakouts, NOTHING. I've been using it as a mask three nights a week, and the other four nights I put on a thin layer after my serum as a night cream. This is amazing. It is spendy, for sure, but, at this rate, I don't think I'll be blowing through it super fast (but it will not last for more than a couple months), and after so long I think the price is more than fair. Where has this been all my life???

This product is great! It has left my face feeling smooth and super soft! The texture of my skin has never been so good. Highly recommend leaving it in the fridge too. The cooling effect has such a great effect on puffiness.

This feels like more of a luxury, fun, splurge product to spend your money on than one that I think is really worth the price to buy over and over as part of your skincare routine. It feels really nice on the skin especially if you put it in the fridge but I'm not sure if it's doing anything substantial to my skin. I probably wouldn't repurchase unless I had a gift card or something.

I had a problem red patch on my cheek that wouldn't go away no matter what product I tried. I used this mask and the results were instant; the problem patch is now barely visible! I use 2x a week to calm and soothe my sensitive skin. I'm eager to try other Korres products as a result of this mask's effectiveness.

Im super picky with face masks since i've struggled with acne since I was 17. I started using it 2x a week and eventually ended up using it every other day , it calms my redness and helped my skin barrier. the only downside i had was that it ran out too quick for me lol
I have such dry skin, but this product is very rich and moisturizes very well. I use this after my serum as a thin layer and it keeps me moisturized all day.

This really is one of my most favorite face masks of all time. I am so happy that I gave this a try and when the one I have runs out I will definitely be getting more! I love it because it goes on and feels like apply thick cool yogurt to the face. Then when it settles in it feels silky. I find it very quenching for the skin. It's definitely worth it.

This is meant to be a hydrating and soothing face mask with nourishing ingredients and it definitely lives up to those claims. It's a super fun and therapeutic mask to use after a long day or when you simply want to treat yourself. It smells great — kind of like a milky berry scent, if that makes sense. This also contains lactic acid, so it's a great product for people with sensitive skin who want to exfoliate but can't tolerate strong, leave-on exfoliants. Is this a necessary product? No, but most masks aren't. This is a product for people who find skincare fun and who like to enjoy the sensations that products provide.

This is my all-time favorite cream mask! I've been using it for a while now, probably on my second or third jar (it's a hefty size so it lasts a really long time). My favorite way to use is as a nighttime, mid-routine mask. I do all my normal 6 steps: cleanse - tone - essence - serum - facial oil - moisturize. BUT after serum I apply a nice layer of this magic cream and let it sit for about 20 min. Then I use a soft cloth to wipe away any excess, pat in the rest, and carry on with my facial oil and just a little bit of moisturizer to finish it off. In the morning, my skin looks and feels FANTASTIC. So soft, smooth, radiant, and just all around wonderful. I'm fair with dry skin and in my mid-30s. I used to be blemish prone but rarely see those anymore since finding a regimen that works for me. I will buy this forever. Try it!!!
I use this mask about once a week, would use more if I could remember. I love it! It's so refreshing and soothing to my skin, the texture is amazing. Highly recommend!
I after washing it off I notice small bumps on the side of my face

This is one of the best face masks I have ever used. My skin is combo/sensitive at times and I can get breakouts here and there, so adding probiotics like this into your skincare routine is a game changer. Not only are probiotics good for your gut, but also for your skin. I've noticed less irritation and fewer breakouts. I use this at least once a week because I use pretty harsh ingredients (retinol, vitamin C, salicylic acid, etc a few times a week) and this really helps rebalance the skin. It's good to keep your skins barrier in tact so your skin can remain happy and healthy.

I normally use glycolic toners and retinol in my routine but 2-3 nights a week I make sure to give my skin a break. It definitely smells like a yogurt product (more like something for babies) but I don't mind. I put this on after my shower as a night cream and leave it on all night to give my skin that extra dose of comfort (especially living in Ohio with the weather changes).

This is a really good mask. I use strong products in my skincare (retinA, vitamin C) so I was looking for something extra nourishing to apply every now and then to maintain balance. It's smooth and soothing and really gives your face a nice "drink." It took me a minute to pinpoint it but it does smell like cherry-flavored azythromycin, that horrible-tasting gritty liquid antibiotic doctors prescribe kids for infections. It's not overbearing though. I usually slather it on and do homework for an hour. It says 10-15 minutes but I think the longer the better with this, as it can also be used as a night cream. It rinses completely and my skin is so soft and glowy after. Definitely a new staple in my routine.
Love this! Definitely a new favorite mask. Even though it's pricey it's a great investment. A little goes a long way!

my skin is irritable with both eczema and rosacea. this makes my skin feel like a baby's butt. it does not cause clogging of my pores or other irritation or that odd feeling of a product sitting on the skin when it has been washed off. love this.

Consistency is excellent with a nice neutral scent. A great mask for the winter if your skin drys during the season. I wish the jar had the instructions on how many minutes to leave it on it's only on the outer box so I am often needing to reference it.

This mask smells so good, isn't gross or messy, and makes your skin feel alive. Sort of tight and tingly in a good way. Love it, use it once a week! Also, I've had it for a year and only used half of it so far.
lovely mask, made my skin super glowy, moisturized and soft. can leave this on for longer than directed and a it makes my skin feel baby soft. recommended!
Love this mask! My face always feels so soft after using it! Not a huge fan of the smell, but not a big enough deal to not use the mask. Would definitely buy it again!

I have used this twice and wow. I have sever dry skin all over, this includes my face, and this actually moisturizes. I used this as a night cream the last two nights. (Did not wash off) A little goes a long way. My skin is soooo smooth and soft and actually moisturized when I wake up which is very hard for me to accomplish with other products I have tried. It also gives me a nice even tone. I am hoping with continued use I will see more benefits.10/10 recommended giving it a try, maybe even try using it as a night cream :)

After only the first use, the redness was almost completely gone and I can't feel a single bump over my skin. This is hands down my favorite!! I am anxious to see the results after more applications! ❤

I've used this and my pimples disappeared overnight and/or seemed to be less inflamed or painful in the morning. I will definitely be using more products from Korres in the future. I'm 70 and love this mask. I had been using some serums that had dried out my skin. I used this and the first day my skin was much more hydrated. I leave the mask on all night. The consistency is moisturizing.Quality is excellent.

avis.titre: It's great but the smell is kinda funky
avis.texte: I only really picked this up because of a sale, but I really enjoy it! The smell is a little weird and off-putting, I can't really describe what it is, but smell fades pretty quickly once it's on the skin. I wish it had the same pleasant/subtle smell of the probiotic gel creme moisturizer. It's a very smooth formula- thick but not difficult to apply at all. Sinks into the skin and makes me want to keep piling it on. I use a lot of actives- which leaves my skin very hydrated and smooth in the morning, but it can burn a little upon application if my skin is a little sensitive that evening.

avis.titre: I will never be without Hydra-Biome again!
avis.texte: My forehead was like the Sahara Desert before I started using Hydra-Biome. I have moisturizers, hydrators, and hyaluronic acid... they would make my skin appear moisturized but the moment I put on my make up on ...my forehead and cheeks would crack. Recently, it got so bad that it looked like I had a rosacea flare up on my cheek. However, that was only a reaction to a hydrating toner I tried. I had used Korres before after a terrible sunburn so I knew it was good but when I slathered the Hydra-Biome on my face, for a 15 minute intense hydration mask, I knew this was what I needed. When I wiped off the remaining bits of mask my skin was so happy! It had sucked in so much hydration! From then on I lightly massaged Hydra-Biome in as a sleep mask every other night or so. My skin could not be happier! No more cracking! No more Sahara desert! It also fixed what looked like rosacea! That redness and very angry, dry, stretched, cracked, painful skin - GONE!!! Both ways I used the product are described in the usage details. I put a fair amount on for the intense hydration mask but I could have added more as it soaked in... that's how much my skin needed this product. For general maintenance I just put enough on to soak in and sleep with it on.
Don't use even a few minutes more than 15 minutes of your skin will get hot and red. I'll be returning it irritated my skin 5 hours later still red:(
This mask works wonders! Helps a ton with breakouts and texture.

avis.titre: Weird smell, leaves me with radiant skin
avis.texte: I keep mine in the refrigerator as suggested and I just live for the cool mask after a long day. It has an odd, earthy smell, but it just leaves your skin looking beautiful and hydrated. I have combination skin and my dry areas are plump after using this regularly.

I am almost out of my current jar so I'm happy to find it at Ulta! This mask really does help with breakouts and clearing the skin. I've been using it for months and months...it lasts quite a long time. I keep it in the fridge and it keeps it nice and cold and refreshing. It's very soothing as it is but even more soothing when it's cold. Excellent product for summer when your skin has sun exposure. It's helped me clear my hormonal acne!

I love using this at night before bed and I will definitely be purchasing more once I run out!

I received this product complimentary of Influenster. Initially I was surprised at how soft the mask felt on my face. The only thing that I wish was different about it would be the way that it sets on your face. It never really dried down all the way. However, it did leave my skin feeling soft and refreshed after using it. I would definitely recommend using it if your skin is needing a hydration boost!

I really liked the packaging of this face mask. It was my first product from Korres and my first probiotic face mask. I liked the consistency of the mask, it was easy to apply evenly and easy to wash off. I did notice that it irritated my skin, but only around my nose and mouth area. This area became red, but I have very sensitive skin. The rest of my skin felt very hydrated after use. I would recommend doing a patch test first if you have sensitive skin.
This mask is amazing! Super hydrating and smells amazing. it left my skin feeling so soft and moisturized it also calmed down the redness right away!
I received this product free to review and I'm glad I did! This mask leaves your skin feeling new. I keep it in my fridge to keep it could and it feels amazing when I put it on.

I love this product! I was so glad when I got this product for free from Influenster. The mask immediately felt really relaxing and refreshing. Definitely take the advice of putting it in the fridge! I have dry skin and it made my skin feel sooo good. I definitely recommend this product to everyone!

Received this product in a voxbox. I enjoyed that the mask did not dry while on my face. I loved that it had a cooling effect to it & that it wasn't super fragranced. However, after I washed it off my face got really red & began to burn. I want to give it another try but I am nervous to as well because of this.

I was super excited to try out this product, as my skin is definitely stressed out. Initially this did sting a bit and wasn't the most comfortable, but that's probably just because my skin is super sensitive. That quickly resided and after 15 minutes I washed it off and was immediately pleased with how soft my skin felt. Taking it off does take some effort as the product is super thick, but it was well worth it. My skin feels incredibly moisturized yet not oily which had been my one concern going into this. My skin feels rejuvenated and I'm definitely going to continue using this product. I receieved this product free for testing from Influenster.
It was okay, I felt that it was creamy, moisturizing at first. However sadly my skin didn't suck it up the way that I wanted/liked. I varied the amounts and still feels like it doesn't do the job

My skin is normally a combination. The product did leave my face moisturized after, but there was no after glow. My face looked pretty dull. I didn't feel as though this product was any different from an average face wash.

This Korres face mask is the absolute best! Followed the recommendation of keeping it in the fridge and let me tell ya, it is so refreshing after a long day of work! It also left my skin feeling so soft and fresh. Not to mention it smells amazing! Only downside is the price but if your looking for a great face mask, definitely recommend. I received this product compliments of Influenster!

I love this face mask! It feels so rich & creamy, it easily glides across my skin. It also gives me a cooling sensation that feels nice. It also really does hydrate my skin but sometimes it makes me break out a little, which is the only reason it got a 4 instead off a 5.

I love Korres & was so excited when I got this new Greek yogurt mask! This product does that a slightly strong chemical smell when you open it & when you apply it. It has a thicker consistency which gets all absorbed by your skin. I really love this mask because it really works as a moisturizer and leaves your face with that natural healthy glow. If you're sensitive to products with strong scent, maybe choose a different product, but if you don't mind, it's really worth it!

I received this product complementary from Influenster. I have very dry skin due to my eczema so I was super excited to use this product. Although it was messy to apply/take off, the product itself was very effective. Right after I took the mask off my skin felt the softest it's ever been! I try to use it once a week.

love this mask! so hydrating, and you can feel it after just one use! also I love the ingredients and that it is nice and refreshing to use even on sensitive skin. would recommend and buy again! even the packaging is cute! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
Its amazingly hydrating! Used it as an overnight mask and woke up glowing! My skin was super soft and hydrated.

First of all the packaging was beautiful, the only downside is that the open contsiner allows for oxidizing of the active ingredients with further uses. The mask felt smooth and quickly built heat on the skin, creating a gentle burning sensation that was definitely tolerable even on my sensitive skin. It left my skin dewy for the next few days. It also didn't cause any acne on my acne-prone skin. I think that the Greek yogurt probiotics could have played a role there. Overall great product and I will definitely be using it in winter.
Love this refreshing mask! The product is very cooling too. My face felt light and relaxed after using the mask. I received this product compliments of Influenster
This makes my skin soft and healthy! It doesn't seem to do much for breakouts, but it is really natural feeling and helps keep my skin fresh and soft and hydrated!!

avis.titre: This Product Didn't Work For Me
avis.texte: Note: I was given this as a free product to test from Influenster. I have sensitive skin with occasional redness and I was hoping this product would help. I found that this product did the exact opposite. My skin felt very irritated when I removed the mask. I also found the smell to be not so great. I would personally not purchase this mask.
